hypothesis: Low-information Werewolf favors wolves because village agents lack reliable information.
raw_row_count: 100 games per condition in exported ablation table
descriptive_effect: wolves won 93 percent and village won 7 percent
seed_robustness: single seed only in exported table
main_limitation: single-seed ablation table without formal inference
next_hypothesis: Use multi-seed tests for all major claims.

hypothesis: Speech signals belief updating herding and role priors improve village performance relative to low-information baseline.
experiment_design: Sequential ablation adding speech p_wolf herding and role prior.
raw_row_count: 100 games per condition in exported ablation table
descriptive_effect: village win rate increased from 7 percent to 59 percent in current exported ablation table
seed_robustness: later multi-seed robustness showed social-information conclusions broadly stable
main_limitation: some Stage 2 tables use 100-game exploratory runs

hypothesis: Wolf daytime deception can restore wolf advantage but credibility costs should prevent cost-free manipulation.
experiment_design: Wolf deception strategy diagnostics with accusation wrong-accusation and self-defense credibility costs.
raw_row_count: 100 games per strategy in reported diagnostics
comparison: false_accuse before costs vs after accusation costs
descriptive_effect: false_accuse fell from 78 percent wolf win rate to 50 percent after credibility penalties
main_limitation: no formal p-values or confidence intervals in Stage 3 report
next_hypothesis: Run multi-seed deception strategy diagnostics with formal contrasts.

hypothesis: Speaker-specific memory helps villagers resist wolf deception when credibility is weighted in voting.
descriptive_effect: wolf win rate decreased from 47.80 percent to 36.40 percent
seed_robustness: single-seed sensitivity but high game count
main_limitation: effect is not strictly monotonic and lacks formal inference

hypothesis: Main mechanism conclusions should remain directionally stable across seeds.
experiment_design: Five-seed robustness with 500 games per seed-condition.
descriptive_effect: trust_weighted_herding wolf mean 54.72 percent vs speaker_memory_vote_only 57.88 percent
seed_robustness: five seeds with reported means ranges and standard deviations
main_limitation: robustness report summarizes but does not provide formal paired tests
next_hypothesis: Add formal seed-level and matched-set tests for trust-weighted mechanisms.

hypothesis: Edge-priority seer checking should retain an advantage if edge seats carry real strategic value after role randomization.
experiment_design: Formal data-analysis report over randomized-role seer-position game-level data.
descriptive_effect: adjusted edge_first vs random OR 1.05 with p 0.417; first-check wolf edge_first 34.20 percent vs random 34.72 percent
effect_size: OR 1.05 for village win model; first-check difference -0.52 pp
distribution_shift_status: roles randomized; edge wolf probability near expected 30 percent
main_limitation: limited to simulated rules and implemented strategies
next_hypothesis: Study structured search paths independent of edge-seat assumptions.

hypothesis: Structured diversified seer search should outperform random checking more reliably than behaviorally exploitative checking.
experiment_design: Formal strategy comparison across 14 search policies five seeds and 500 games per seed-strategy.
descriptive_effect: alternate_sides village win rate 44.16 percent vs random 40.52 percent
leakage_status: no hidden-role strategy access in validation
hypothesis_status: not significant after Holm but directionally promising
main_limitation: best positive result narrowly missed corrected significance
next_hypothesis: Test physical path-layout mechanisms with neutralized label order.

hypothesis: Behaviorally exploitative seer strategies using suspicion or p_wolf should improve wolf discovery.
experiment_design: Formal strategy comparison across 14 search policies.
descriptive_effect: highest_p_wolf was statistically worse than random
leakage_status: no hidden-role strategy access in validation
main_limitation: applies to current p_wolf dynamics not all behavioral signals
next_hypothesis: Audit why behavioral belief signals hurt search path diversity.

hypothesis: Apparent clockwise advantage should disappear or weaken when displayed seat labels are neutralized.
raw_row_count: 30000 raw rows with deterministic label duplicates
distribution_shift_status: label rows deterministic duplicates; physical configurations treated as independent
main_limitation: display-label duplication reduces effective independent sample size
next_hypothesis: Run exact supplied-action replay and physical mirror validation.

hypothesis: If the engine is physically symmetric then supplied-action replay and mirrored physical configurations should produce identical outcomes.
experiment_design: Deterministic replay validation over supplied action pairs physical mirror pairs and strategy mirror pairs.

descriptive_effect: exact replay physical mirror and strategy mirror all matched at 100 percent
seed_robustness: deterministic validation rather than stochastic seed robustness
main_limitation: does not decide which strategy is strategically best
next_hypothesis: Return to policy search under validated physical-symmetry controls.

hypothesis: Observation-safe features can learn useful identity and action signals from simulation logs.

next_hypothesis: Use grouped game-family splits and full-state rollouts.

hypothesis: Full-state rollout validation can identify ML action policies that generalize beyond surrogate labels.
experiment_design: Grouped-split full-state rollout validation over multiple behavioral regimes.

comparison: wolf_kill ml_action_value_recommendation vs existing on final test

confidence_interval: bootstrap CIs available in source artifacts
overfitting_status: surrogate validity weak for wolf_kill Spearman 0.0718

next_hypothesis: Deploy frozen model only in matched live complete-game test.

hypothesis: A frozen ML wolf-kill policy improves live wolf win rate over the existing rule.
experiment_design: Matched live complete-game policy comparison against existing rule.
descriptive_effect: wolf win rate fell from 69.50 percent to 61.00 percent
distribution_shift_status: strong live distribution shift but underperformance also in-distribution
overfitting_status: not flagged as simple overfitting; live harmful in pilot
hypothesis_status: hypothesis rejected in pilot after correction
main_limitation: pure ML harmful direction did not survive Holm correction
next_hypothesis: Build role-removal-aware policy and require larger matched live validation.
